brief:
The health system in Gaza is approaching systemic failure, according to Ma'an Wire, with medical infrastructure suffering severe degradation amid ongoing operational constraints. Hospitals and clinics across the territory face critical shortages of supplies, fuel, and personnel, leaving medical staff unable to provide adequate care to the population.

The deterioration has created a cascade of failures across primary and secondary healthcare services, compounding existing humanitarian challenges in the territory. Medical facilities continue to operate under severely restricted conditions, with many unable to maintain basic functions or treat patients effectively.
title: Gaza's health system faces collapse as medical infrastructure deteriorates
